am.L: የያቄ ልጅ የአጉር ቃሎች፣ የትንቢት ቃል። ሰውዬው ለኢቲኤል፣ ለኢቲኤልና ለኡካል እንዲህ ይላል፦

ja.L: ヤケの子アグルの言葉、託宣。その人はイティエルに、イティエルとウカルに告げる。
ja.B: ヤケの子アグルの言葉、託宣である。この人はイティエルに、イティエルとウカルに、こう告げる。
ja.R: これは、ヤケの息子アグルの言葉である。これは、アグルが告げる大切な知らせである。アグルは、イティエルとウカルに、こう語った。

decisions.reason: The word (massa) is a "burden," the term for a prophet's solemn message (Isaiah 13:1; Malachi 1:1). It may instead be a name: Massa was a son of Ishmael and the people descended from him in north Arabia (Genesis 25:14). Then Agur, and perhaps Lemuel (31:1), were from Massa.

decisions.choice: the man declares: a formal opening of a solemn utterance
decisions.reason: The phrase (neum haggever) introduces the sayings of Balaam (Numbers 24:3, 15) and David's last words (2 Samuel 23:1).

decisions.choice: to Ithiel, to Ithiel and Ucal: two names, as the Hebrew vowels read
alternatives: I am weary, O God, I am weary, O God, and worn out
There is no God; there is no God, and I can prevail
decisions.reason: The vowels added to the text read two personal names, the people Agur speaks to. The same letters, divided differently, can be read as a cry: "I am weary, O God, I am weary, O God, and I am spent." That reading fits the humble confession of verses 2–3. Another division reads a skeptic's claim that Agur goes on to answer. The meaning is very uncertain.
Agur follows the terms note. The other names have no settled French form in common use; they are transcribed from the Hebrew as the English does, with the French "é" for the final vowel of Jakeh.

decisions.choice: "Aguri mwana wa Yake", "Ithieli" and "Ukali" for the names
decisions.reason: The names take the usual Swahili shape, ending in a vowel. "Yake" is spelled like the word for "his", but as a name after "mwana wa" and with its capital it reads as a name.

decisions.choice: Agur hijo de Jaqué; Itiel; Ucal
decisions.reason: The names take their usual Spanish spelling: "qu" for the k sound before e, and "t" and "c" where English writes "th" and "c".

The names take the Protestant transliterations the terms note and the older Vietnamese Bible use. Agur speaks for himself as "tôi", the plain first person of a speaker who is not the father of chapters 1–29.

The names take the forms of the Protestant tradition (style guide section 5; the terms note gives "아굴"). "Massa" is a weighty, solemn message (meaning decision m1); Literal names it with the word for an oracle, Balanced says what it is, and Readable says "the message he gave", as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: Agur, filho de Jaque; o oráculo (L, B); Itiel, Ucal
decisions.reason: Names in their Brazilian spelling (PRO_NOTE). Massa' is "o oráculo", a prophet's solemn message, as the English takes it (m1); if it is the north Arabian people of Genesis 25:14, the Portuguese name would be "Massá".

Following the meaning decision (a weighty message), massa is the word used for Balaam's oracles (Numbers 23-24) and for 2 Kings 9:25 in the Amharic on main. ሸክም, the literal "burden", does not say "message" to a modern reader; ማሳ, the terms list's form of the name, is the footnote's alternative. Readable says "his message" (መልእክቱ), as the English does.

Agur son of Jakeh as the terms list. Ithiel and Ucal are read as two names, as the meaning decision has it, and transcribed from the Hebrew; they occur nowhere else in the Amharic so far (Ithiel of Nehemiah 11:7 is not yet drafted and should match).

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in the Amharic of Proverbs 30 (30:4-9)
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting that capitalizes pronouns for God has nothing to change in Amharic; pronouns for God are written plainly (docs/amharic-style.md section 7).

The names are transcribed from the Hebrew; Ithiel keeps the form of Nehemiah 11:7 in this translation. The oracle (massa) is a weighty message (meaning m1), "भारी वचन", as 2 Kings 9:25 renders the same word in this translation.
"The man declares" is a solemn opening (meaning m2), here the word used for a prophet's utterance; Hindi says it with "कहता है" before the colon, so the words that follow stand as what he declares.

The names occur only here; they take the traditional Russian forms, as the history note does for names (Иеффай, Иессей), so that a reader finds the familiar people. Ithiel is repeated as the Hebrew has it (m3).
massa is a weighty message, the word for a prophet's oracle (m1); Readable says "весть", as the English "message".

decisions.choice: Names: Agur "アグル", Jakeh "ヤケ", Ithiel "イティエル", Ucal "ウカル" (as the Hebrew vowels read, two names)
decisions.reason: Names not met before in the Japanese; transcribed from the Hebrew as other OT names are, following meaning m3 (two hearers).

decisions.choice: hammassa' "託宣" (L, B), as massa' in 2 Kings 9:25; Readable "大切な知らせ" for the English Readable "message"; not the place name "マサ"
alternatives: "マサの人" (Massa as a place, as some read it)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads massa' as "the oracle", a weighty message (m1), not as the tribe or land of Massa; Japanese follows it.

records.literal_gloss: Surely I [am] more stupid than anyone, and the understanding of a person [is] not mine.

en.L: Surely I [am] more brutish than anyone, \q and I do not have [the] understanding of a human.
en.B: I am surely the most ignorant of all people; \q I lack ordinary human understanding.
en.R: I am more ignorant than anyone else. \q I do not have the understanding that people should have.

fr.L: Certes, je [suis] plus stupide que quiconque, \q et je n’ai pas l’intelligence d’un homme.
fr.B: Je suis vraiment le plus ignorant de tous ; \q il me manque l’intelligence ordinaire des humains.
fr.R: Je suis plus ignorant que tous les autres. \q Je n’ai pas l’intelligence que les gens devraient avoir.

sw.L: Hakika mimi [ni] mjinga kuliko mtu yeyote, \q wala sina ufahamu wa mwanadamu.
sw.B: Hakika mimi ndiye mjinga kuliko watu wote; \q sina ufahamu wa kawaida wa mwanadamu.
sw.R: Mimi ni mjinga kuliko mtu mwingine yeyote. \q Sina ufahamu ambao watu wanapaswa kuwa nao.

es.L: Ciertamente yo [soy] más bruto que nadie, \q y no tengo [el] entendimiento de un ser humano.
es.B: Sin duda soy el más ignorante de todos; \q me falta el entendimiento humano común.
es.R: Soy más ignorante que cualquier otra persona. \q No tengo el entendimiento que la gente debería tener.

vi.L: Chắc chắn tôi [là kẻ] ngu muội hơn mọi người, \q và tôi không có sự thông sáng của loài người.
vi.B: Chắc chắn tôi là người ngu dốt nhất trong mọi người; \q tôi thiếu cả sự thông sáng thông thường của con người.
vi.R: Tôi ngu dốt hơn bất cứ ai. \q Tôi không có sự hiểu biết mà con người cần phải có.

ko.L: 정녕 나는 누구보다 짐승 같고, \q 내게는 사람의 명철이 없다.
ko.B: 나는 참으로 모든 사람 가운데 가장 무지하고, \q 사람이 마땅히 가져야 할 명철도 없다.
ko.R: 나는 누구보다도 아는 것이 없다. \q 사람이 가져야 할 깨달음도 없다.

pt.L: Certamente eu [sou] mais bruto que qualquer um, \q e não tenho [o] entendimento de um ser humano.
pt.B: Com certeza sou o mais ignorante de todos; \q não tenho o entendimento comum das pessoas.
pt.R: Eu sou mais ignorante do que qualquer outra pessoa. \q Não tenho o entendimento que as pessoas deveriam ter.

am.L: በእርግጥ እኔ ከማንም ይልቅ ደንቆሮ ነኝ፤ \q የሰውም ማስተዋል የለኝም።
am.B: በእርግጥ ከሰዎች ሁሉ እጅግ ደንቆሮ ነኝ፤ \q ተራ የሰው ማስተዋል እንኳ የለኝም።
am.R: ከማንም በላይ ምንም የማላውቅ ነኝ። \q ሰው ሊኖረው የሚገባ ማስተዋል የለኝም።

hi.L: निश्चय मैं हर किसी से अधिक पशु-समान [हूँ], \q और मुझ में मनुष्य की समझ नहीं।
hi.B: निश्चय मैं सब लोगों में सबसे अज्ञानी हूँ; \q मुझ में साधारण मनुष्य की समझ भी नहीं।
hi.R: मैं किसी भी दूसरे व्यक्ति से ज़्यादा अज्ञानी हूँ। \q मुझ में वह समझ नहीं जो लोगों में होनी चाहिए।

ru.L: Поистине, я тупее всякого человека, \q и нет у меня разума человеческого.
ru.B: Я, конечно, самый невежественный из людей; \q нет у меня обычного человеческого разума.
ru.R: Я невежественнее всех. \q У меня нет того понимания, которое должно быть у человека.

ja.L: まことに、わたしはだれよりも獣のように愚かで、 \q わたしには人の悟りがない。
ja.B: わたしは、まことに、だれよりも愚かな者だ。 \q 人並みの悟りもない。
ja.R: わたしは、ほかのだれよりも、ものを知らない。 \q 人が持っているはずの、物事を見分ける力も、わたしにはない。

decisions.reason: The word (baar) is used of a person no wiser than a beast (12:1; Psalm 73:22). Agur confesses that human wisdom cannot reach God (verses 3–4); the confession is humble, perhaps with some irony.
baar is the dullness of a beast (m1), "тупой" as at 12:1; "глупый" is kept for kesil.

decisions.choice: Agur's words (30:2-14) without 「 」, as the English, in the plain poetic style at every level; ba'ar "獣のように愚か" (L) as 12:1
decisions.reason: The English sets Agur's speech without quotation marks, so the Japanese has none; plain style holds for the poems of Proverbs (PRO-1 notes).

records.literal_gloss: And I have not learned wisdom, and knowledge of [the] Holy One I know.

en.L: I have not learned wisdom, \q nor do I know [the] knowledge of [the] Holy One.
en.B: I have not learned wisdom, \q nor do I have knowledge of the Holy One.
en.R: I have not learned wisdom. \q I do not know the Holy God.

fr.L: Je n’ai pas appris la sagesse, \q et je ne possède pas la connaissance du Saint.
fr.B: Je n’ai pas appris la sagesse, \q et je n’ai pas la connaissance du Saint.
fr.R: Je n’ai pas appris la sagesse. \q Je ne connais pas le Dieu saint.

sw.L: Sijajifunza hekima, \q wala sijui maarifa ya Aliye Mtakatifu.
sw.B: Sijajifunza hekima, \q wala sina maarifa ya Aliye Mtakatifu.
sw.R: Sijajifunza hekima. \q Simjui Mungu Mtakatifu.

es.L: No he aprendido sabiduría, \q ni conozco [el] conocimiento del Santo.
es.B: No he aprendido sabiduría, \q ni tengo conocimiento del Santo.
es.R: No he aprendido sabiduría. \q No conozco al Dios santo.

vi.L: Tôi chưa học được sự khôn ngoan, \q cũng không biết tri thức về Đấng Thánh.
vi.B: Tôi chưa học được sự khôn ngoan, \q cũng chẳng có tri thức về Đấng Thánh.
vi.R: Tôi chưa học được sự khôn ngoan. \q Tôi không biết Đức Chúa Trời Thánh.

ko.L: 나는 지혜를 배우지 못했고, \q 거룩하신 분에 대한 지식도 알지 못한다.
ko.B: 나는 지혜를 배우지 못했고, \q 거룩하신 분을 아는 지식도 없다.
ko.R: 나는 지혜를 배우지 못했다. \q 거룩하신 하나님을 알지 못한다.

pt.L: Não aprendi a sabedoria, \q nem conheço [o] conhecimento do Santo.
pt.B: Não aprendi a sabedoria, \q nem tenho o conhecimento do Santo.
pt.R: Não aprendi a sabedoria. \q Não conheço o Deus Santo.

am.L: ጥበብን አልተማርኩም፤ \q የቅዱሱንም እውቀት አላውቅም።
am.B: ጥበብን አልተማርኩም፤ \q የቅዱሱም እውቀት የለኝም።
am.R: ጥበብን አልተማርኩም። \q ቅዱሱን አምላክ አላውቀውም።

hi.L: मैंने बुद्धि नहीं सीखी, \q और न मैं पवित्र का ज्ञान जानता हूँ।
hi.B: मैंने बुद्धि नहीं सीखी, \q और न मुझे पवित्र परमेश्वर का ज्ञान है।
hi.R: मैंने बुद्धि नहीं सीखी। \q मैं पवित्र परमेश्वर को नहीं जानता।

ru.L: Я не научился мудрости \q и не знаю знания Святого.
ru.B: Я не научился мудрости \q и не имею знания о Святом.
ru.R: Я не научился мудрости. \q Я не знаю Святого Бога.

ja.L: わたしは知恵を学ばず、 \q 聖なる方の知識を知らない。
ja.B: わたしは知恵を学んだこともなく、 \q 聖なる方を知る知識もない。
ja.R: わたしは、知恵を学んだことがない。 \q 聖なる神を知らない。

decisions.choice: nor do I know the knowledge of the Holy One
alternatives: yet I have knowledge of the Holy One
decisions.reason: The negative of the first line carries over to the second. Without it, the line would mean that Agur does know God, in contrast to his lack of learning.
The plural (qedoshim) is a plural of majesty for God, as in 9:10.

The Holy One is God (meaning m2). Literal keeps the bare title, as "इस्राएल का पवित्र" in the poetry note; Balanced and Readable add "परमेश्वर" so that a Hindi reader does not take "पवित्र" as a plain adjective.

source.text: מִ֤י עָלָֽה־שָׁמַ֨יִם׀וַיֵּרַ֡ד מִ֤י אָֽסַף־ר֨וּחַ׀בְּחָפְנָ֡יו מִ֤י צָֽרַר־מַ֨יִם׀בַּשִּׂמְלָ֗ה מִ֭י הֵקִ֣ים כָּל־אַפְסֵי־אָ֑רֶץ מַה־שְּׁמ֥וֹ וּמַֽה־שֶּׁם־בְּ֝נ֗וֹ כִּ֣י תֵדָֽע׃

records.literal_gloss: Who has gone up [to] heaven and come down? Who has gathered [the] wind in the hollow of his hands? Who has wrapped [the] waters in a cloak? Who has set up all [the] ends of [the] earth? What [is] his name, and what [is] the name of his son? Surely you know!

en.L: Who has gone up [to] heaven and come down? Who has gathered [the] wind in the hollow of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} hands? Who has wrapped [the] waters in a garment? \q Who has set up all [the] ends of [the] earth? \q What [is] {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name, and what [is] the name of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} son? Surely you know!
en.B: Who has climbed up to heaven and come back down? Who has caught the wind in the palms of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} hands? Who has bundled the waters in a cloak? \q Who has fixed all the boundaries of the earth? \q What is {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name, and the name of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} son? Tell me, if you know!
en.R: Has anyone gone up to heaven and come back? Who can hold the wind in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} hands? Who can wrap up the oceans in a coat? \q Who made the edges of the world? \q What is {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name? What is {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} son's name? Tell me if you know!

fr.L: Qui est monté [aux] cieux et en est descendu ? Qui a recueilli le vent dans le creux de {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} mains ? Qui a enveloppé les eaux dans un vêtement ? \q Qui a établi toutes les extrémités de la terre ? \q Quel [est] {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom, et quel [est] le nom de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} fils ? Certainement, tu le sais !
fr.B: Qui est monté au ciel et en est redescendu ? Qui a saisi le vent dans le creux de {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} mains ? Qui a serré les eaux dans un manteau ? \q Qui a fixé toutes les limites de la terre ? \q Quel est {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom, et le nom de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} fils ? Dis-le-moi, si tu le sais !
fr.R: Quelqu’un est-il monté au ciel et en est-il revenu ? Qui peut tenir le vent dans {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} mains ? Qui peut envelopper les océans dans un manteau ? \q Qui a fait les bords du monde ? \q Quel est {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom ? Quel est le nom de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} fils ? Dis-le-moi, si tu le sais !

sw.L: Ni nani aliyepanda [mbinguni] na kushuka? Ni nani aliyekusanya upepo katika viganja vya mikono {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}? Ni nani aliyefunga maji katika vazi? \q Ni nani aliyeweka miisho yote ya dunia? \q Jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} [ni] nani, na jina la mwana {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} [ni] nani? Hakika unajua!
sw.B: Ni nani aliyepanda mpaka mbinguni na kushuka tena? Ni nani aliyeukamata upepo katika viganja vya mikono {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}? Ni nani aliyeyafunga maji katika joho? \q Ni nani aliyeiweka mipaka yote ya dunia? \q Jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} ni nani, na jina la mwana {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}? Niambie, kama unajua!
sw.R: Je, kuna mtu aliyepanda mbinguni na kurudi? Ni nani awezaye kushika upepo mikononi {{deity_pronoun:mwake|Mwake}}? Ni nani awezaye kufunga bahari katika koti? \q Ni nani aliyefanya miisho ya dunia? \q Jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} ni nani? Jina la mwana {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} ni nani? Niambie kama unajua!

es.L: ¿Quién subió [al] cielo y bajó? ¿Quién recogió [el] viento en el hueco de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} manos? ¿Quién envolvió [las] aguas en una vestidura? \q ¿Quién estableció todos [los] confines de [la] tierra? \q ¿Cuál [es] {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre, y cuál [es] el nombre de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} hijo? ¡Seguro que lo sabes!
es.B: ¿Quién ha subido al cielo y ha vuelto a bajar? ¿Quién ha atrapado el viento en las palmas de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} manos? ¿Quién ha envuelto las aguas en un manto? \q ¿Quién ha fijado todos los límites de la tierra? \q ¿Cuál es {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre, y el nombre de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} hijo? ¡Dímelo, si lo sabes!
es.R: ¿Ha subido alguien al cielo y ha regresado? ¿Quién puede sostener el viento en {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} manos? ¿Quién puede envolver los océanos en un abrigo? \q ¿Quién hizo los extremos del mundo? \q ¿Cuál es {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre? ¿Cómo se llama {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} hijo? ¡Dímelo si lo sabes!

vi.L: Ai đã lên trời rồi xuống? Ai đã gom gió trong lòng bàn tay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}? Ai đã gói nước trong chiếc áo? \q Ai đã lập mọi đầu cùng của đất? \q Danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [là] gì, và danh con trai {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [là] gì? Chắc anh biết!
vi.B: Ai đã leo lên trời rồi trở xuống? Ai đã nắm bắt gió trong lòng bàn tay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}? Ai đã bọc nước trong tấm áo choàng? \q Ai đã định mọi ranh giới của đất? \q Danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là gì, và danh con trai {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là gì? Nếu anh biết, hãy nói cho tôi!
vi.R: Có ai đã lên trời rồi trở về không? Ai có thể giữ gió trong tay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}? Ai có thể gói biển cả trong một chiếc áo? \q Ai đã làm nên các đầu cùng của thế giới? \q Tên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là gì? Tên con trai {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là gì? Nếu anh biết thì nói cho tôi đi!

ko.L: 누가 하늘에 올라갔다가 내려왔느냐? 누가 바람을 자기 두 손 우묵한 곳에 모았느냐? 누가 물을 옷으로 감쌌느냐? \q 누가 땅의 모든 끝을 세웠느냐? \q 그분의 이름은 무엇이며, 그분의 아들의 이름은 무엇이냐? 너는 정녕 알 것이다!
ko.B: 하늘에 올라갔다가 다시 내려온 이가 누구냐? 바람을 두 손바닥에 움켜쥔 이가 누구냐? 물을 겉옷에 싸서 묶은 이가 누구냐? \q 땅의 모든 경계를 정한 이가 누구냐? \q 그분의 이름이 무엇이며, 그분의 아들의 이름이 무엇이냐? 네가 안다면 말해 보아라!
ko.R: 하늘에 올라갔다가 돌아온 사람이 있느냐? 누가 바람을 손에 쥘 수 있느냐? 누가 바다를 겉옷에 쌀 수 있느냐? \q 누가 세상의 끝을 만들었느냐? \q 그분의 이름이 무엇이냐? 그분의 아들의 이름은 무엇이냐? 알면 말해 보아라!

pt.L: Quem subiu aos céus e desceu? Quem juntou o vento na concha das {{deity_pronoun:suas|Suas}} mãos? Quem envolveu as águas numa veste? \q Quem estabeleceu todos os confins da terra? \q Qual [é] o nome {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}, e qual [é] o nome do filho {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}? Certamente você sabe!
pt.B: Quem subiu ao céu e voltou a descer? Quem apanhou o vento nas palmas das {{deity_pronoun:suas|Suas}} mãos? Quem embrulhou as águas num manto? \q Quem fixou todos os limites da terra? \q Qual é o nome {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}, e o nome do filho {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}? Diga-me, se você sabe!
pt.R: Alguém já subiu ao céu e voltou? Quem consegue segurar o vento nas {{deity_pronoun:suas|Suas}} mãos? Quem consegue embrulhar os oceanos num casaco? \q Quem fez os limites do mundo? \q Qual é o nome {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}? Qual é o nome do filho {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}? Diga-me, se você sabe!

am.L: ወደ ሰማይ የወጣ፣ የወረደስ ማን ነው? ነፋስን በእጆቹ መዳፍ የሰበሰበ ማን ነው? ውኆችን በልብስ የጠቀለለ ማን ነው? \q የምድርን ዳርቻዎች ሁሉ ያጸና ማን ነው? \q ስሙ ማን ነው? የልጁስ ስም ማን ነው? በእርግጥ ታውቃለህ!
am.B: ወደ ሰማይ ወጥቶ የተመለሰ ማን ነው? ነፋስን በእጁ መዳፍ የያዘ ማን ነው? ውኆችን በመጎናጸፊያ የጠቀለለ ማን ነው? \q የምድርን ዳርቻዎች ሁሉ የወሰነ ማን ነው? \q ስሙ ማን ነው? የልጁስ ስም? የምታውቅ ከሆነ ንገረኝ!
am.R: ወደ ሰማይ ወጥቶ የተመለሰ ሰው አለን? ነፋስን በእጁ ሊይዝ የሚችል ማን ነው? ውቅያኖሶችን በልብስ ሊጠቀልል የሚችል ማን ነው? \q የዓለምን ዳርቻዎች የሠራ ማን ነው? \q ስሙ ማን ነው? የልጁስ ስም ማን ነው? የምታውቅ ከሆነ ንገረኝ!

hi.L: कौन स्वर्ग पर चढ़ा और उतरा? किसने अपनी मुट्ठियों में हवा बटोरी? किसने जल को वस्त्र में बाँधा? \q किसने पृथ्वी की सब सीमाएँ ठहराईं? \q उनका नाम क्या [है], और उनके पुत्र का नाम क्या [है]? निश्चय तुम जानते हो!
hi.B: कौन स्वर्ग पर चढ़कर फिर नीचे उतरा है? किसने हवा को अपनी हथेलियों में थाम लिया है? किसने जल को चादर में लपेट लिया है? \q किसने पृथ्वी की सारी सीमाएँ ठहराई हैं? \q उनका नाम क्या है, और उनके पुत्र का नाम क्या है? अगर तुम जानते हो, तो मुझे बताओ!
hi.R: क्या कोई स्वर्ग पर चढ़कर वापस आया है? कौन हवा को अपने हाथों में थाम सकता है? कौन समुद्रों को कपड़े में लपेट सकता है? \q पृथ्वी के छोर किसने बनाए? \q उनका नाम क्या है? उनके पुत्र का नाम क्या है? अगर तुम जानते हो, तो मुझे बताओ!

ru.L: Кто поднялся на небеса и спустился? Кто собрал ветер в свои горсти? Кто увязал воды в одеяние? \q Кто поставил все края земли? \q Каково {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} имя, и каково имя {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} сына? Ведь ты знаешь!
ru.B: Кто поднимался на небо и снова спускался? Кто поймал ветер в свои ладони? Кто завернул воды в плащ? \q Кто установил все пределы земли? \q Как {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} имя и как имя {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} сына? Скажи, если знаешь!
ru.R: Поднимался ли кто-нибудь на небо и возвращался ли назад? Кто может удержать ветер в своих руках? Кто может завернуть океаны в плащ? \q Кто создал края земли? \q Как {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} зовут? Как зовут {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} сына? Скажи мне, если знаешь!

ja.L: だれが天に上り、また下ったか？だれが風をその手のくぼみに集めたか？だれが水を衣で包んだか？ \q だれが地のすべての果てを定めたか？ \q その名は何か、その子の名は何か？あなたは知っているではないか！
ja.B: だれが天に上り、また下って来たか？だれが風をたなごころに捕らえたか？だれが水を外套に包んだか？ \q だれが地の果てをすべて定めたか？ \q その名は何か、その子の名は何か？知っているなら、言ってみなさい！
ja.R: 天に上って、また帰って来た人がいるだろうか？だれが風を手につかむことができるだろうか？だれが海を上着で包むことができるだろうか？ \q だれが世界の果てを造ったのか？ \q その名は何か？その子の名は何か？知っているなら、教えてくれ！

decisions.choice: who has done these things: only God
decisions.reason: The questions are like those God asks Job (Job 38:4–11). No human has gone up to heaven to learn its secrets; only the Creator holds wind and water and fixed the earth's ends. The answer to "What is his name?" is God.

alternatives: God's people Israel, called his son
a son who could reveal God
decisions.reason: In the Old Testament Israel is called God's son (Exodus 4:22; Hosea 11:1), and the king is called his son (Psalm 2:7). The question may ask who could know God as a son knows his father. Christian readers have also heard in it a pointer to the Son who came down from heaven (John 3:13).

decisions.choice: surely you know: a challenge to the hearer
decisions.reason: The words echo God's challenge to Job (Job 38:5), with a note of irony: no one can answer.
The challenge is put as a direct question, so the irony is plain.

decisions.choice: "Certainement, tu le sais !" at Literal; "Dis-le-moi, si tu le sais !" at Balanced and Readable
alternatives: "Tu le sais sûrement !" at every level
decisions.reason: As the English: Literal keeps the Hebrew's challenge as it stands, the other levels say it as a French challenge would be said (meaning decision m3).
Agur speaks to his hearers as an equal, not as a father to a son, so the polite adult "anh" replaces the "con" of the earlier chapters; "ngươi" would sound archaic. A reviewer may prefer "bạn".

decisions.choice: o nome dele ... o nome do filho dele (with the deity_pronoun setting); você
alternatives: o seu nome ... o seu filho
decisions.reason: Agur challenges the hearer with "você", so "seu" would read as "your name"; "dele" keeps the questions about God (m1). "Filho" stays lowercase, as in the English, leaving open the readings of m2.

decisions.choice: The Hebrew's questions, not the wording of John 3:13
alternatives: "ከ... በቀር ወደ ሰማይ የወጣ ማንም የለም" (John 3:13 on main)
decisions.reason: John 3:13 echoes this verse but does not quote it, so the Amharic follows the Hebrew's questions and does not take the Gospel's sentence; only the plain phrase "ወደ ሰማይ የወጣ" is shared.

Devanagari has no capital letters, so the deity_pronoun setting has nothing to change and the Hindi has no deity_pronoun spans (style guide, section 7). The one who has done these things can only be God (meaning m1), so his name and his son's take the honorific "उनका", "उनके", as God does in the third person throughout this translation, where the English capitalizes the pronoun in its alternative.

The first question is echoed in John 3:13 ("no one has gone up into heaven except the one who came down"). The Hindi uses the verbs of John 3:13 in this translation, "स्वर्ग पर चढ़ा" and "उतरा", because they are the natural Hindi words for the Hebrew; nothing else in the verse is shaped to the Gospel.

decisions.choice: "свои горсти", "свои ладони", "своих руках" without a deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: The English has a span on "his hands"; Russian uses the reflexive "свой", which takes no span (style guide section 7). "Его имя" and "его сына" take the span, as in the English.

decisions.choice: "поднялся ... спустился", "увязал воды в одеяние", "поставил все края земли"
decisions.reason: Drafted from the Hebrew; Literal keeps every image but does not follow the familiar Synodal line word for word.

decisions.choice: "その名" / "その子の名", with no pronoun for God
decisions.reason: The English capitalises the pronouns for God; Japanese has no deity_pronoun spans and leaves the pronoun out, as the questions leave the answer to the hearer (meaning m1, m3).

source.text: כָּל־אִמְרַ֣ת אֱל֣וֹהַּ צְרוּפָ֑ה מָגֵ֥ן ה֝֗וּא לַֽחֹסִ֥ים בּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Every word of God [is] refined; a shield he [is] to those who take refuge in him.

en.L: Every word of God [is] refined; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} [is] a shield to those who take refuge in {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.B: Every word God speaks is proven true; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is a shield to all who take refuge in {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.R: Everything God says is true and pure. \q He protects everyone who goes to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} for safety.

fr.L: Toute parole de Dieu [est] éprouvée ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} [est] un bouclier pour ceux qui se réfugient en {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.
fr.B: Toute parole que Dieu dit a fait ses preuves ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est un bouclier pour tous ceux qui se réfugient en {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.
fr.R: Tout ce que Dieu dit est vrai et pur. \q Il protège tous ceux qui viennent se mettre à l’abri auprès de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.

sw.L: Kila neno la Mungu [limesafishwa]; \q {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} [ni] ngao kwa wale wanaokimbilia {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}.
sw.B: Kila neno asemalo Mungu limethibitika kuwa kweli; \q {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} ni ngao kwa wote wanaokimbilia {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}.
sw.R: Kila asemalo Mungu ni kweli na safi. \q Yeye humlinda kila mtu anayekimbilia {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}} ili awe salama.

es.L: Toda palabra de Dios [es] refinada; \q {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} [es] escudo para los que se refugian en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.
es.B: Toda palabra que Dios dice ha sido probada; \q {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} es escudo para todos los que se refugian en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.
es.R: Todo lo que Dios dice es verdadero y puro. \q Él protege a todos los que acuden a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} en busca de seguridad.

vi.L: Mọi lời của Đức Chúa Trời [đều] tinh luyện; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [là] cái khiên cho những ai nương náu nơi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Mọi lời Đức Chúa Trời phán đều đã được thử nghiệm là chân thật; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là cái khiên cho tất cả những ai nương náu nơi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Mọi điều Đức Chúa Trời phán đều chân thật và tinh sạch. \q Ngài bảo vệ mọi người chạy đến với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} để được an toàn.

ko.L: 하나님의 말씀은 모두 정련되었다. \q 그분께 피하는 자들에게 그분은 방패이시다.
ko.B: 하나님께서 하시는 말씀은 모두 참되다는 것이 드러났다. \q 그분은 그분께 피하는 모든 사람의 방패이시다.
ko.R: 하나님께서 하시는 말씀은 모두 참되고 깨끗하다. \q 그분은 안전을 찾아 그분께 오는 모든 사람을 지켜 주신다.

pt.L: Toda palavra de Deus [é] refinada; \q {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} [é] um escudo para os que se refugiam {{deity_pronoun:nele|Nele}}.
pt.B: Toda palavra que Deus fala é comprovada; \q {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} é um escudo para todos os que se refugiam {{deity_pronoun:nele|Nele}}.
pt.R: Tudo o que Deus diz é verdadeiro e puro. \q Ele protege todos os que vão até {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} em busca de segurança.

am.L: የአምላክ ቃል ሁሉ የጠራ ነው፤ \q በእርሱ ለሚጠለሉ እርሱ ጋሻ ነው።
am.B: አምላክ የሚናገረው ቃል ሁሉ የተፈተነና እውነት ነው፤ \q በእርሱ ለሚጠለሉ ሁሉ ጋሻ ነው።
am.R: አምላክ የሚናገረው ሁሉ እውነትና ንጹሕ ነው። \q ወደ እርሱ ለመጠለል የሚሄዱትን ሁሉ ይጠብቃል።

hi.L: परमेश्वर का हर वचन ताया हुआ [है]; \q वे उनके लिए ढाल [हैं] जो उनकी शरण लेते हैं।
hi.B: परमेश्वर का हर वचन परखा हुआ और खरा है; \q वे उन सबके लिए ढाल हैं जो उनकी शरण लेते हैं।
hi.R: परमेश्वर जो कुछ कहते हैं, वह सच्चा और शुद्ध है। \q वे हर उस व्यक्ति की रक्षा करते हैं जो सुरक्षा के लिए उनके पास भागकर आता है।

ru.L: Всякое слово Бога очищено; \q {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} — щит для тех, кто находит убежище в {{deity_pronoun:нём|Нём}}.
ru.B: Всякое слово Бога испытано и верно; \q {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} — щит для всех, кто ищет в {{deity_pronoun:нём|Нём}} укрытия.
ru.R: Всё, что говорит Бог, истинно и чисто. \q Он защищает всех, кто бежит к {{deity_pronoun:нему|Нему}} за защитой.

ja.L: 神の言葉はすべて精錬されている。 \q 神は、ご自分に身を避ける者たちの盾である。
ja.B: 神の語られる言葉はすべて確かである。 \q 神は、ご自分に身を避けるすべての者の盾である。
ja.R: 神が言われることは、すべて本当で、混じりけがない。 \q 神は、守ってもらおうとして来る人を、みな守ってくださる。

decisions.reason: The name here is Eloah, the form used often in Job, not the LORD's personal name.

decisions.choice: refined: tested like metal in a furnace, without flaw
decisions.reason: The word (tsaruph) is used of silver refined of dross. The verse is nearly the same as Psalm 18:31 and 2 Samuel 22:31. What humans cannot reach (verses 2–4) God gives in his word.
The terms list gives Eloah as አምላክ, so it stays apart from the divine name (30:9), which is እግዚአብሔር.

decisions.choice: the wording of 2 Samuel 22:31 and Psalm 18
decisions.reason: The verse says what 2 Samuel 22:31 and its parallel in Psalm 18 say of the LORD's word, with Eloah, "God", in place of the divine name (meaning m1). Where the Hebrew is the same, the Hindi keeps the wording those passages have in this translation at each level: "ताया हुआ" (refined, meaning m2), "ढाल", "शरण लेते हैं".

decisions.choice: the wording of 2 Samuel 22:31 (Psalm 18:30) in this translation
decisions.reason: The second half of the verse says what 2 Samuel 22:31 says of the LORD's word and of God as a shield, so each level keeps its Russian: "очищено" (L), "испытано и верно" (B), and the three forms of taking refuge. Here the Hebrew names God as Eloah, "Бог".

source.text: אַל־תּ֥וֹסְףְּ עַל־דְּבָרָ֑יו פֶּן־יוֹכִ֖יחַ בְּךָ֣ וְנִכְזָֽבְתָּ׃פ

records.literal_gloss: Do not add to his words, lest he rebuke you and you are proved a liar.

en.L: Do not add to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} words, \q or {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will rebuke you and you will be proved a liar.
en.B: Do not add anything to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} words, \q or {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will correct you and show you to be a liar.
en.R: Do not add your own ideas to what God says. \q If you do, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will correct you and show that you are lying.

fr.L: N’ajoute rien à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} paroles, \q de peur qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ne te reprenne et que tu ne sois trouvé menteur.
fr.B: N’ajoute rien à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} paroles, \q sinon {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} te corrigera et montrera que tu es un menteur.
fr.R: N’ajoute pas tes propres idées à ce que Dieu dit. \q Sinon, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} te corrigera et montrera que tu mens.

sw.L: Usiongeze kwa maneno {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, \q asije akakukemea, nawe ukaonekana mwongo.
sw.B: Usiongeze chochote kwa maneno {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, \q la sivyo atakurekebisha na kukuonyesha kuwa mwongo.
sw.R: Usiongeze mawazo yako mwenyewe kwa yale anayosema Mungu. \q Ukifanya hivyo, atakurekebisha na kuonyesha kwamba unasema uongo.

es.L: No añadas a {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} palabras, \q o {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} te reprenderá y quedarás como mentiroso.
es.B: No le añadas nada a {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} palabras, \q o {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} te corregirá y mostrará que eres un mentiroso.
es.R: No añadas tus propias ideas a lo que Dios dice. \q Si lo haces, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} te corregirá y mostrará que estás mintiendo.

vi.L: Đừng thêm vào lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q kẻo {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} quở trách anh và anh bị xem là kẻ nói dối.
vi.B: Đừng thêm gì vào lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q kẻo {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sửa trị anh và cho thấy anh là kẻ nói dối.
vi.R: Đừng thêm ý riêng của anh vào những gì Đức Chúa Trời phán. \q Nếu anh làm thế, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ sửa trị anh và cho thấy anh đang nói dối.

ko.L: 그분의 말씀에 더하지 마라. \q 그분께서 너를 책망하시고 네가 거짓말쟁이로 드러날까 [두렵다].
ko.B: 그분의 말씀에 아무것도 보태지 마라. \q 그러지 않으면 그분께서 너를 꾸짖으시고 너를 거짓말쟁이로 드러내실 것이다.
ko.R: 하나님께서 하신 말씀에 네 생각을 보태지 마라. \q 그렇게 하면 그분께서 너를 바로잡으시고 네가 거짓말하고 있다는 것을 드러내실 것이다.

pt.L: Não acrescente às palavras {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}, \q senão {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} repreenderá você, e você será achado mentiroso.
pt.B: Não acrescente nada às palavras {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}, \q senão {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} vai corrigir você e mostrar que você é mentiroso.
pt.R: Não acrescente as suas próprias ideias ao que Deus diz. \q Se fizer isso, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} vai corrigir você e mostrar que você está mentindo.

am.L: በቃሎቹ ላይ አትጨምር፤ \q እንዳይገሥጽህ፣ ሐሰተኛም እንዳትገኝ።
am.B: በቃሎቹ ላይ ምንም አትጨምር፤ \q አለዚያ ያርምሃል፤ ውሸታም መሆንህንም ያጋልጣል።
am.R: አምላክ በሚናገረው ላይ የራስህን ሐሳብ አትጨምር። \q ብትጨምር ያርምሃል፤ ውሸታም መሆንህንም ያሳያል።

hi.L: उनके वचनों में [कुछ] मत जोड़ो, \q नहीं तो वे तुम्हें डाँटेंगे और तुम झूठे ठहरोगे।
hi.B: उनके वचनों में कुछ भी मत जोड़ो, \q नहीं तो वे तुम्हें सुधारेंगे और तुम्हें झूठा साबित करेंगे।
hi.R: परमेश्वर जो कहते हैं, उसमें अपने विचार मत जोड़ो। \q अगर तुम ऐसा करोगे, तो वे तुम्हें सुधारेंगे और दिखा देंगे कि तुम झूठ बोल रहे हो।

ru.L: Не прибавляй к {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} словам, \q чтобы {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} не обличил тебя и ты не оказался лжецом.
ru.B: Ничего не прибавляй к {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} словам, \q иначе {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} поправит тебя и покажет, что ты лжец.
ru.R: Не добавляй своих мыслей к тому, что говорит Бог. \q Иначе {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} поправит тебя и покажет, что ты лжёшь.

ja.L: その言葉に付け加えるな。 \q さもないと、神はあなたを責め、あなたは偽り者とされる。
ja.B: 神の言葉に何も付け加えてはならない。 \q さもないと、神はあなたを戒め、あなたがうそつきであることを明らかにされる。
ja.R: 神が言われることに、自分の考えを付け加えてはいけない。 \q もしそうすれば、神はあなたを正し、あなたがうそを言っていることを明らかにされる。

decisions.choice: do not add to his words: as in Deuteronomy 4:2
decisions.reason: Compare Deuteronomy 4:2; 12:32; Revelation 22:18.
The verse echoes Deuteronomy 4:2, whose Amharic says "አትጨምሩ"; the same verb is kept, in the singular of the Hebrew here. Revelation 22:18 echoes it loosely and is not copied.
The warning recalls Deuteronomy 4:2 (meaning m1), which this translation renders "उसमें न कुछ जोड़ना"; the same verb "जोड़ना" is kept here.
The line echoes Deuteronomy 4:2 (m1), so Literal and Balanced use the verb of the Russian Deuteronomy; Readable says "не добавляй", as Deuteronomy's Readable does.

source.text: שְׁ֭תַּיִם שָׁאַ֣לְתִּי מֵאִתָּ֑ךְ אַל־תִּמְנַ֥ע מִ֝מֶּ֗נִּי בְּטֶ֣רֶם אָמֽוּת׃

records.literal_gloss: Two [things] I ask from you; do not withhold [them] from me before I die:

en.L: Two [things] I ask of {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}; \q do not withhold [them] from me before I die:
en.B: I ask {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} for two things; \q grant them to me before I die:
en.R: God, I ask {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} for two things. \q Please give them to me while I am still alive:

fr.L: Je {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} demande deux [choses] ; \q ne [me les] refuse pas avant que je meure :
fr.B: Je {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} demande deux choses ; \q accorde-les-moi avant que je meure :
fr.R: Dieu, je {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} demande deux choses. \q Donne-les-moi, s’il {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} plaît, pendant que je suis encore en vie :

sw.L: Mambo mawili ninaomba {{deity_pronoun:kwako|Kwako}}; \q usininyime kabla sijafa:
sw.B: Ninakuomba {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} mambo mawili; \q nijalie kabla sijafa:
sw.R: Mungu, ninakuomba {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} mambo mawili. \q Tafadhali nipe ningali hai:

es.L: Dos [cosas] {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} pido; \q no me [las] niegues antes de que muera:
es.B: Dos cosas {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} pido; \q concédemelas antes de morir:
es.R: Dios, dos cosas {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} pido. \q Por favor, dámelas mientras todavía estoy vivo:

vi.L: Tôi xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} hai [điều]; \q xin đừng từ chối [chúng] cho tôi trước khi tôi chết:
vi.B: Tôi cầu xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} hai điều; \q xin ban cho tôi trước khi tôi qua đời:
vi.R: Lạy Đức Chúa Trời, tôi xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} hai điều. \q Xin ban cho tôi khi tôi còn sống:

ko.L: 두 가지를 제가 주님께 구합니다. \q 제가 죽기 전에 [그것을] 제게 거절하지 마십시오.
ko.B: 제가 주님께 두 가지를 구합니다. \q 제가 죽기 전에 그것을 이루어 주십시오.
ko.R: 하나님, 제가 두 가지를 구합니다. \q 제가 살아 있는 동안 그것을 주십시오.

pt.L: Duas [coisas] eu {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} peço; \q não [as] negues a mim antes que eu morra:
pt.B: Duas coisas eu {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} peço; \q concede-as a mim antes que eu morra:
pt.R: Deus, eu {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} peço duas coisas. \q Por favor, dá-me essas coisas enquanto eu ainda estou vivo:

am.L: ሁለት [ነገሮችን] ከአንተ እለምናለሁ፤ \q ሳልሞት አትከልክለኝ፦
am.B: ሁለት ነገሮችን እለምንሃለሁ፤ \q ከመሞቴ በፊት ስጠኝ፦
am.R: አምላክ ሆይ፣ ሁለት ነገሮችን እለምንሃለሁ። \q በሕይወት ሳለሁ እባክህ ስጠኝ፦

hi.L: मैं तुझसे दो [बातें] माँगता हूँ; \q मेरे मरने से पहले [उन्हें] मुझसे मत रोक:
hi.B: मैं तुझसे दो बातें माँगता हूँ; \q मेरे मरने से पहले उन्हें मुझे दे:
hi.R: हे परमेश्वर, मैं तुझसे दो बातें माँगता हूँ। \q जब तक मैं जीवित हूँ, कृपया उन्हें मुझे दे:

ru.L: Двух [вещей] я прошу у {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}}; \q не откажи мне [в них], прежде чем я умру:
ru.B: Я прошу {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}} о двух вещах; \q дай мне их, прежде чем я умру:
ru.R: Боже, я прошу {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}} о двух вещах. \q Пожалуйста, дай мне их, пока я жив:

ja.L: 二つのことを、わたしはあなたに求める。 \q わたしが死ぬ前に、それを拒まないでほしい。
ja.B: わたしは二つのことをあなたに願う。 \q わたしが死ぬ前に、それをかなえてほしい。
ja.R: 神よ、わたしはあなたに二つのことを願う。 \q わたしが生きているうちに、それをかなえてほしい。

decisions.choice: you: God, to whom Agur prays
decisions.reason: The only prayer in Proverbs. The two requests follow in verse 8: keep me from falsehood, and give me neither poverty nor riches.
Readable names the one addressed, so that it is clear this is a prayer.

decisions.choice: Agur speaks to God with "tu" ("je te demande"), with the deity-pronoun setting on "te"
decisions.reason: As the terms note sets for prayer: French addresses God with "tu". The setting on "te" mirrors the English "you|You".
Agur prays to God with the ordinary "tú" of prayer in Spanish, as the Psalms do; "usted" would sound distant rather than reverent.

decisions.choice: "Ngài" for "you" when Agur prays to God; Agur still says "tôi"
decisions.reason: The terms note has the speaker address God as "Ngài" or "Chúa"; "Ngài" keeps the deity_pronoun setting the English has. Agur keeps "tôi", as the psalmist does in Psalm 23, so his voice does not change when he turns to prayer.

decisions.choice: Agur's prayer (verses 7-9) is in 합쇼체 with "저/제", and God is addressed as "주님"
decisions.reason: As the terms note and the style guide (section 7a): a person speaking to God uses 합쇼체 and the humble "저". Korean addresses God by a title, not a pronoun, so "you" is "주님" (Readable "하나님", as the English Readable says "God"); there are no deity_pronoun spans.

decisions.choice: tu: te, negues, concede, dá (with the deity_pronoun setting)
decisions.reason: The only prayer in Proverbs (m1): Agur speaks to God with "tu", as people pray in Brazilian Portuguese (style §4; PRO_NOTE), through verse 9; "te", "ti" take the deity_pronoun setting where the English "you" does. The imperatives take the clitic after the verb ("concede-as", "dá-me"), as prayers are written.
Agur turns to pray to God (meaning m1), so he says "तू", as everyone praying to God does in this translation.

decisions.choice: Agur's prayer (30:7-9) to God as "あなた" in the plain style, with requests as "〜てほしい" (not です・ます, not a bare imperative)
decisions.reason: God addressed in poetry is あなた in the plain style (OT supplement); requests to God take "〜てほしい" as in Job's speeches.

source.text: שָׁ֤וְא׀וּֽדְבַר־כָּזָ֡ב הַרְחֵ֬ק מִמֶּ֗נִּי רֵ֣אשׁ וָ֭עֹשֶׁר אַל־תִּֽתֶּן־לִ֑י הַ֝טְרִיפֵ֗נִי לֶ֣חֶם חֻקִּֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: Emptiness and a word of falsehood put far from me; poverty and riches do not give to me; let me eat the food of my portion,

en.L: Put emptiness and a word of falsehood far from me; \q do not give me poverty or riches; \q let me eat the bread of my portion,
en.B: Keep falsehood and lies far away from me; \q give me neither poverty nor wealth, \q but feed me with the bread I need each day,
en.R: Keep me from lying and from things that are false. \q Do not make me poor, and do not make me rich. \q Just give me the food I need each day.

fr.L: Éloigne de moi la fausseté et la parole de mensonge ; \q ne me donne ni pauvreté ni richesse ; \q fais-moi manger le pain de ma part,
fr.B: Tiens loin de moi la fausseté et les mensonges ; \q ne me donne ni la pauvreté ni la richesse, \q mais nourris-moi du pain qu’il me faut chaque jour,
fr.R: Garde-moi de mentir et de ce qui est faux. \q Ne me rends pas pauvre, et ne me rends pas riche. \q Donne-moi seulement la nourriture dont j’ai besoin chaque jour.

sw.L: Uweke mbali nami ubatili na neno la uongo; \q usinipe umaskini wala utajiri; \q unilishe mkate wa fungu langu,
sw.B: Uweke mbali nami udanganyifu na uongo; \q usinipe umaskini wala mali, \q bali unilishe mkate ninaohitaji kila siku,
sw.R: Unizuie nisiseme uongo wala nisifuate mambo ya uongo. \q Usinifanye maskini, wala usinifanye tajiri. \q Unipe tu chakula ninachohitaji kila siku.

es.L: Aleja de mí la vanidad y la palabra mentirosa; \q no me des ni pobreza ni riqueza; \q dame a comer el pan de mi porción,
es.B: Mantén lejos de mí la falsedad y la mentira; \q no me des ni pobreza ni abundancia, \q sino aliméntame con el pan que necesito cada día,
es.R: Aléjame de la mentira y de las cosas falsas. \q No me hagas pobre, y no me hagas rico. \q Solo dame la comida que necesito cada día.

vi.L: Xin cất sự hư không và lời dối trá xa khỏi tôi; \q xin đừng cho tôi nghèo khó hay giàu sang; \q xin cho tôi ăn bánh theo phần của tôi,
vi.B: Xin giữ sự giả dối và lời nói dối xa khỏi tôi; \q xin đừng cho tôi nghèo khó, cũng đừng cho tôi giàu có, \q nhưng xin nuôi tôi bằng phần bánh tôi cần mỗi ngày,
vi.R: Xin giữ tôi khỏi nói dối và khỏi những điều giả dối. \q Xin đừng làm cho tôi nghèo, cũng đừng làm cho tôi giàu. \q Chỉ xin cho tôi thức ăn tôi cần mỗi ngày.

ko.L: 헛된 것과 거짓말을 제게서 멀리하시고, \q 가난도 부도 제게 주지 마시고, \q 제 몫의 양식을 먹여 주십시오.
ko.B: 거짓과 속임수를 제게서 멀리해 주시고, \q 가난하게도 부유하게도 하지 마시고, \q 날마다 필요한 양식을 먹여 주십시오.
ko.R: 제가 거짓말하지 않게 하시고 헛된 것을 멀리하게 해 주십시오. \q 저를 가난하게도 하지 마시고 부자로도 만들지 마십시오. \q 날마다 필요한 양식만 주십시오.

pt.L: Afasta de mim a vaidade e a palavra de mentira; \q não me dês pobreza nem riqueza; \q deixa-me comer o pão da minha porção,
pt.B: Mantém longe de mim a falsidade e a mentira; \q não me dês nem pobreza nem riqueza, \q mas sustenta-me com o pão de que preciso a cada dia,
pt.R: Guarda-me de mentir e das coisas falsas. \q Não me faças pobre nem me faças rico. \q Dá-me apenas a comida de que preciso a cada dia.

am.L: ከንቱነትንና የሐሰትን ቃል ከእኔ አርቅ፤ \q ድህነትንም ባለጠግነትንም አትስጠኝ፤ \q የድርሻዬን እንጀራ አብላኝ፤
am.B: ሐሰትንና ውሸትን ከእኔ አርቅ፤ \q ድህነትንም ሆነ ሀብትን አትስጠኝ፤ \q ይልቁንም በየቀኑ የሚያስፈልገኝን እንጀራ መግበኝ፤
am.R: ከውሸትና ከሐሰተኛ ነገር ጠብቀኝ። \q ድሀም አታድርገኝ፤ ሀብታምም አታድርገኝ። \q በየቀኑ የሚያስፈልገኝን ምግብ ብቻ ስጠኝ።

hi.L: व्यर्थता और झूठ की बात मुझसे दूर कर; \q मुझे न कंगाली दे, न धन; \q मुझे मेरे भाग की रोटी खिला,
hi.B: झूठ और छल को मुझसे दूर रख; \q मुझे न ग़रीबी दे, न अमीरी, \q पर हर दिन की ज़रूरत की रोटी मुझे खिला,
hi.R: मुझे झूठ बोलने से और झूठी बातों से बचाए रख। \q मुझे न ग़रीब बना, न अमीर। \q बस मुझे हर दिन ज़रूरत का भोजन दे।

ru.L: Пустоту и слово лжи удали от меня; \q бедности и богатства не давай мне; \q дай мне есть хлеб моей доли,
ru.B: Удали от меня ложь и обман; \q не давай мне ни бедности, ни богатства, \q но корми меня хлебом, который нужен мне на каждый день,
ru.R: Не дай мне лгать и иметь дело с ложью. \q Не делай меня бедным и не делай меня богатым. \q Просто дай мне еду, которая нужна мне на каждый день.

ja.L: むなしさと偽りの言葉を、わたしから遠ざけてほしい。 \q 貧しさも富も、わたしに与えないでほしい。 \q わたしに定められた分のパンで、わたしを養ってほしい。
ja.B: 偽りとうそを、わたしから遠ざけてほしい。 \q 貧しさも富も与えず、 \q 日ごとに必要なパンで、わたしを養ってほしい。
ja.R: わたしがうそをついたり、偽りのことをしたりしないようにしてほしい。 \q わたしを貧しくもせず、金持ちにもしないでほしい。 \q 毎日必要な食べ物だけを与えてほしい。

decisions.choice: emptiness: what is false and worthless
decisions.reason: The word (shav) is used of empty, deceptive things, including false worship (Exodus 20:7; Psalm 31:7).

decisions.choice: the bread of my portion: the food allotted to me day by day
decisions.reason: The word (hoq) is a fixed share, as in 31:15. Compare the daily manna (Exodus 16:4) and the prayer for daily bread (Matthew 6:11).

decisions.choice: o pão de que preciso (B); a comida de que preciso (R)
decisions.reason: The fixed daily share (m2) recalls the prayer for daily bread in Matthew 6:11, whose Portuguese says "o pão de que precisamos" (B) and "a comida de que precisamos" (R); these lines use the same words in the singular. Literal keeps "o pão da minha porção".

decisions.choice: "እንጀራ" for the bread of my portion
decisions.reason: Bread as daily food is እንጀራ, as in the Lord's Prayer on main (Luke 11:3), which this prayer recalls without being quoted.

source.text: פֶּ֥ן אֶשְׂבַּ֨ע׀וְכִחַשְׁתִּי֮ וְאָמַ֗רְתִּי מִ֥י יְה֫וָ֥ה וּפֶֽן־אִוָּרֵ֥שׁ וְגָנַ֑בְתִּי וְ֝תָפַ֗שְׂתִּי שֵׁ֣ם אֱלֹהָֽי׃פ

records.literal_gloss: lest I be full and deny and say, "Who [is] YHWH?" and lest I become poor and steal and lay hold of the name of my God.

en.L: lest I be full and deny [{{deity_pronoun:you|You}}] and say, \q "Who [is] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}?" \q or lest I become poor and steal, \q and profane the name of my God.
en.B: so that I do not have too much and disown {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, asking, \q "Who is {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}?" \q or have too little and steal, \q and so bring disgrace on my God's name.
en.R: If I have too much, I might forget {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} and say, "Who is {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}?" \q If I am too poor, I might steal and bring shame on my God's name.

fr.L: de peur que, rassasié, je ne [{{deity_pronoun:te|Te}}] renie et ne dise : \q « Qui [est] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ? » \q ou que, devenu pauvre, je ne vole, \q et ne profane le nom de mon Dieu.
fr.B: pour que je n’aie pas trop et ne {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} renie en disant : \q « Qui est {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ? » \q ni trop peu et que je ne vole, \q couvrant ainsi de honte le nom de mon Dieu.
fr.R: Si j’ai trop, je risque de {{deity_pronoun:t|T}}oublier et de dire : « Qui est {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ? » \q Si je suis trop pauvre, je risque de voler et de couvrir de honte le nom de mon Dieu.

sw.L: nisije nikashiba nikakukana na kusema, \q "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [ni] nani?" \q au nisije nikawa maskini nikaiba, \q nikalitia unajisi jina la Mungu wangu.
sw.B: nisije nikawa na vingi mno nikakukana, nikisema, \q "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni nani?" \q au nikawa na kidogo mno nikaiba, \q na hivyo nikaliletea aibu jina la Mungu wangu.
sw.R: Nikiwa na vingi mno, huenda nikakusahau na kusema, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni nani?" \q Nikiwa maskini mno, huenda nikaiba na kuliletea aibu jina la Mungu wangu.

es.L: no sea que me sacie y [{{deity_pronoun:te|Te}}] niegue y diga: \q «¿Quién [es] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}?», \q o no sea que me empobrezca y robe, \q y profane el nombre de mi Dios.
es.B: para que no tenga demasiado y {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} rechace diciendo: \q «¿Quién es {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}?», \q ni tenga muy poco y robe, \q y así deshonre el nombre de mi Dios.
es.R: Si tengo demasiado, podría olvidarme de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} y decir: «¿Quién es {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}?». \q Si soy demasiado pobre, podría robar y traer vergüenza al nombre de mi Dios.

vi.L: kẻo tôi no nê mà chối bỏ [{{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}] và nói: \q "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [là] ai?" \q hoặc kẻo tôi trở nên nghèo khó mà trộm cắp, \q và làm ô danh Đức Chúa Trời của tôi.
vi.B: kẻo khi có quá nhiều, tôi chối bỏ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mà hỏi: \q "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} là ai?" \q hoặc khi có quá ít, tôi đi trộm cắp \q và làm ô nhục danh Đức Chúa Trời của tôi.
vi.R: Nếu có quá nhiều, tôi có thể quên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và nói: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} là ai?" \q Nếu quá nghèo, tôi có thể trộm cắp và làm xấu hổ danh Đức Chúa Trời của tôi.

ko.L: 제가 배불러서 [주님을] 부인하며 \q "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 누구냐?" 하고 말하지 않도록, \q 또 제가 가난해져서 도둑질하여 \q 제 하나님의 이름을 욕되게 하지 않도록 [해 주십시오].
ko.B: 제가 너무 많이 가져서 주님을 모른다 하며 \q "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 누구냐?" 하고 말하지 않게 하시고, \q 너무 적게 가져서 도둑질하여 \q 제 하나님의 이름을 더럽히지 않게 해 주십시오.
ko.R: 제가 너무 많이 가지면 주님을 잊고 "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 누구냐?" 하고 말할지도 모릅니다. \q 제가 너무 가난하면 도둑질하여 제 하나님의 이름에 먹칠을 할지도 모릅니다.

pt.L: para que eu não me farte e [{{deity_pronoun:te|Te}}] negue e diga: \q "Quem [é] {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}?" \q ou para que eu não empobreça e furte, \q e profane o nome do meu Deus.
pt.B: para que eu não tenha demais e {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} renegue, dizendo: \q "Quem é {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}?" \q nem tenha de menos e roube, \q e assim traga desonra ao nome do meu Deus.
pt.R: Se eu tiver demais, posso me esquecer de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} e dizer: "Quem é {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}?" \q Se eu for pobre demais, posso roubar e envergonhar o nome do meu Deus.

am.L: ጠግቤ [አንተን] እንዳልክድ፣ እንዲህም እንዳልል፦ \q «{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ማን ነው?» \q ወይም ደኽዬ እንዳልሰርቅ፣ \q የአምላኬንም ስም እንዳላቃልል።
am.B: ብዙ አግኝቼ እንዳልክድህና እንዲህ ብዬ እንዳልጠይቅ፦ \q «{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ማን ነው?» \q ወይም አጥቼ እንዳልሰርቅ፣ \q በዚህም የአምላኬን ስም እንዳላሰድብ።
am.R: ብዙ ቢኖረኝ ልረሳህና «{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ማን ነው?» ልል እችላለሁ። \q በጣም ድሀ ብሆን ደግሞ ልሰርቅና የአምላኬን ስም ላዋርድ እችላለሁ።

hi.L: कहीं ऐसा न हो कि मैं तृप्त होकर [तेरा] इनकार करूँ और कहूँ, \q "{{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कौन है?" \q या कहीं ऐसा न हो कि मैं कंगाल होकर चोरी करूँ, \q और अपने परमेश्वर के नाम को अपवित्र करूँ।
hi.B: ताकि ऐसा न हो कि मेरे पास बहुत हो जाए और मैं तेरा इनकार करके पूछूँ, \q "{{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कौन है?" \q या मेरे पास बहुत कम हो और मैं चोरी करूँ, \q और इस तरह अपने परमेश्वर के नाम का अपमान करूँ।
hi.R: अगर मेरे पास बहुत ज़्यादा होगा, तो हो सकता है मैं तुझे भूल जाऊँ और कहूँ, "{{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कौन है?" \q अगर मैं बहुत ग़रीब हो जाऊँ, तो हो सकता है मैं चोरी करूँ और अपने परमेश्वर के नाम पर कलंक लगाऊँ।

ru.L: чтобы, насытившись, я не отрёкся [от {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}}] и не сказал: \q «Кто такой {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}?» \q или, обеднев, не стал красть \q и не опорочил имени моего Бога.
ru.B: чтобы, имея слишком много, не отречься от {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}}, сказав: \q «Кто такой {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}?» \q или, имея слишком мало, не начать красть \q и не навлечь позор на имя моего Бога.
ru.R: Если у меня будет слишком много, я могу забыть {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}} и сказать: «Кто такой {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}?» \q Если я буду слишком беден, я могу начать воровать и опозорить имя моего Бога.

ja.L: わたしが満ち足りて[あなたを]否み、 \q 「{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}とはだれか？」と言うことのないように。 \q また、わたしが貧しくなって盗み、 \q わたしの神の名を汚すことのないように。
ja.B: わたしが満ち足りて、あなたを否み、 \q 「{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}とはだれだ？」と言わないように。 \q また、乏しくなって盗み、 \q わたしの神の名に恥を負わせないように。
ja.R: もし、ありあまるほど持っていたら、わたしはあなたを忘れて、「{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}とはだれだ？」と言うかもしれない。 \q もし、とても貧しかったら、わたしは盗みをして、わたしの神の名に恥をかかせるかもしれない。

decisions.choice: full and deny: forgetting God in plenty
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy 8:10–14 warns that when Israel has eaten its fill it may forget the LORD. Compare Pharaoh's "Who is the LORD?" (Exodus 5:2).

decisions.choice: lay hold of the name of my God: bring it into disrepute
decisions.reason: The verb (taphas) is to seize; to handle God's name is to profane it, perhaps by swearing falsely when accused of theft (Leviticus 6:2–3).
The verb has no object. Since Agur is praying, the one he would deny is God himself.

decisions.choice: "እንዳላቃልል" (L), "እንዳላሰድብ" (B), "ላዋርድ" (R) for laying hold of God's name
decisions.reason: Following the meaning decision (bringing the name into disrepute): ማቃለል is the word for profaning at Literal, as Leviticus on main; Readable says ማዋረድ.
As the English, the object of "deny" is supplied: Agur is praying, so the one he would deny is God himself. The supplied pronoun takes the deity_pronoun span like any other.

source.text: אַל־תַּלְשֵׁ֣ן עֶ֭בֶד אֶל־אֲדֹנָ֑יו פֶּֽן־יְקַלֶּלְךָ֥ וְאָשָֽׁמְתָּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Do not slander a slave to his master, lest he curse you and you are held guilty.

en.L: Do not slander a servant to his master, \q lest he curse you and you be held guilty.
en.B: Do not speak against a servant to his master, \q or the servant will call down a curse on you, and you will be found guilty.
en.R: Do not tell lies about a servant to his boss. \q The servant might ask God to punish you, and you will be guilty.

fr.L: Ne calomnie pas un esclave auprès de son maître, \q de peur qu’il ne te maudisse et que tu ne sois tenu pour coupable.
fr.B: Ne parle pas contre un serviteur auprès de son maître, \q sinon le serviteur appellera sur toi une malédiction, et tu seras reconnu coupable.
fr.R: Ne dis pas de mensonges sur un serviteur à son patron. \q Le serviteur pourrait demander à Dieu de te punir, et tu serais coupable.

sw.L: Usimchongee mtumwa kwa bwana wake, \q asije akakulaani nawe ukahesabiwa kuwa na hatia.
sw.B: Usimseme vibaya mtumishi kwa bwana wake, \q la sivyo mtumishi huyo atakulaani, nawe utapatikana na hatia.
sw.R: Usiseme uongo juu ya mtumishi kwa bosi wake. \q Mtumishi huyo anaweza kumwomba Mungu akuadhibu, nawe utakuwa na hatia.

es.L: No calumnies al esclavo ante su amo, \q no sea que te maldiga y seas hallado culpable.
es.B: No hables mal de un siervo ante su amo, \q o el siervo pedirá una maldición sobre ti, y serás hallado culpable.
es.R: No digas mentiras sobre un siervo a su patrón. \q El siervo podría pedirle a Dios que te castigue, y serás culpable.

vi.L: Đừng vu khống đầy tớ với chủ nó, \q kẻo nó nguyền rủa anh và anh bị kể là có tội.
vi.B: Đừng nói xấu một đầy tớ với chủ của người ấy, \q kẻo người đầy tớ ấy nguyền rủa anh, và anh bị xem là có tội.
vi.R: Đừng nói dối về một người đầy tớ với chủ của người ấy. \q Người đầy tớ ấy có thể xin Đức Chúa Trời phạt anh, và anh sẽ mắc tội.

ko.L: 종을 그의 주인에게 헐뜯지 마라. \q 그가 너를 저주하여 네가 죄를 쓸까 [두렵다].
ko.B: 종을 그 주인에게 헐뜯지 마라. \q 그러지 않으면 그 종이 너를 저주하여 네가 벌을 받게 된다.
ko.R: 종에 대해 그 주인에게 거짓말하지 마라. \q 그 종이 하나님께 너를 벌해 달라고 빌 것이고, 너는 죄인이 될 것이다.

pt.L: Não calunie o escravo diante do senhor dele, \q para que ele não o amaldiçoe e você seja tido por culpado.
pt.B: Não fale mal de um servo ao senhor dele, \q senão o servo vai lançar uma maldição sobre você, e você será considerado culpado.
pt.R: Não conte mentiras sobre um servo ao patrão dele. \q O servo pode pedir a Deus que castigue você, e você vai ser culpado.

am.L: ባሪያን በጌታው ፊት አትወንጅል፤ \q እንዳይረግምህ፣ በደለኛም እንዳትሆን።
am.B: አገልጋይን በጌታው ፊት አትክሰስ፤ \q አለዚያ አገልጋዩ ይረግምሃል፤ አንተም በደለኛ ሆነህ ትገኛለህ።
am.R: ስለ አገልጋይ ለአለቃው ውሸት አትናገር። \q አገልጋዩ እግዚአብሔር እንዲቀጣህ ሊለምን ይችላል፤ አንተም በደለኛ ትሆናለህ።

hi.L: किसी दास की उसके स्वामी से चुग़ली न करना, \q कहीं ऐसा न हो कि वह तुम्हें शाप दे और तुम दोषी ठहरो।
hi.B: किसी दास के विरुद्ध उसके स्वामी से कुछ मत कहो, \q नहीं तो वह दास तुम्हें शाप देगा, और तुम दोषी ठहरोगे।
hi.R: किसी दास के बारे में उसके मालिक से झूठ मत बोलो। \q वह दास परमेश्वर से तुम्हें दंड देने को कह सकता है, और तुम दोषी ठहरोगे।

ru.L: Не клевещи на раба его господину, \q чтобы он не проклял тебя и ты не оказался виновным.
ru.B: Не наговаривай на слугу его хозяину, \q иначе слуга призовёт на тебя проклятие, и ты окажешься виновным.
ru.R: Не лги о слуге его хозяину. \q Слуга может попросить Бога наказать тебя, и ты будешь виновен.

ja.L: しもべのことを、その主人に中傷するな。 \q さもないと、そのしもべはあなたを呪い、あなたは罪ある者とされる。
ja.B: しもべのことを、その主人に悪く言ってはならない。 \q さもないと、しもべはあなたを呪い、あなたは罪に定められる。
ja.R: しもべについて、その主人にうそを言ってはいけない。 \q そのしもべは、あなたを罰してほしいと神に願うかもしれない。そうなれば、あなたは罪のある者になる。

decisions.choice: his master, as the scribes' reading has it
decisions.reason: The written form and the scribes' reading differ in spelling; both mean "his master."

decisions.choice: he will curse you: the slandered servant
decisions.reason: A servant has no other defense than to call on God against the slanderer, and the curse is deserved (contrast 26:2).
As in 29:19 and 30:22: ʿeved is "раб" at Literal, and "слуга" at Balanced and Readable, where the English says "servant".

source.text: דּ֭וֹר אָבִ֣יו יְקַלֵּ֑ל וְאֶת־אִ֝מּ֗וֹ לֹ֣א יְבָרֵֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: A generation curses its father, and its mother it does not bless.

en.L: [There is] a generation [that] curses its father \q and does not bless its mother.
en.B: There are people who curse their fathers \q and never speak well of their mothers.
en.R: Some people curse their fathers. \q They have nothing good to say about their mothers.

fr.L: [Il y a] une génération [qui] maudit son père \q et ne bénit pas sa mère.
fr.B: Il y a des gens qui maudissent leur père \q et ne disent jamais de bien de leur mère.
fr.R: Certains maudissent leur père. \q Ils n’ont rien de bon à dire sur leur mère.

sw.L: [Kuna] kizazi [kinachomlaani] baba yake \q wala hakimbariki mama yake.
sw.B: Kuna watu wanaowalaani baba zao \q na kamwe hawawasemi mama zao vizuri.
sw.R: Watu wengine huwalaani baba zao. \q Hawana neno jema la kusema juu ya mama zao.

es.L: [Hay] una generación [que] maldice a su padre \q y no bendice a su madre.
es.B: Hay gente que maldice a su padre \q y nunca habla bien de su madre.
es.R: Algunos maldicen a su padre. \q No tienen nada bueno que decir de su madre.

vi.L: [Có] một dòng dõi nguyền rủa cha mình \q và không chúc phước cho mẹ mình.
vi.B: Có những người nguyền rủa cha mình \q và chẳng bao giờ nói tốt về mẹ mình.
vi.R: Có người nguyền rủa cha mình. \q Họ chẳng có lời nào tốt để nói về mẹ mình.

ko.L: 자기 아버지를 저주하고 \q 자기 어머니를 축복하지 않는 세대가 [있다].
ko.B: 아버지를 저주하고 \q 어머니에게 좋은 말 한마디 하지 않는 사람들이 있다.
ko.R: 어떤 사람들은 자기 아버지를 저주한다. \q 자기 어머니에게 좋은 말을 하나도 하지 않는다.

pt.L: [Há] uma geração [que] amaldiçoa o seu pai \q e não abençoa a sua mãe.
pt.B: Há gente que amaldiçoa o pai \q e nunca fala bem da mãe.
pt.R: Algumas pessoas amaldiçoam o pai. \q Não têm nada de bom para dizer da mãe.

am.L: አባቱን የሚረግም ትውልድ [አለ]፤ \q እናቱንም አይመርቅም።
am.B: አባቶቻቸውን የሚረግሙ ሰዎች አሉ፤ \q ስለ እናቶቻቸውም አንድም መልካም ቃል አይናገሩም።
am.R: አንዳንድ ሰዎች አባቶቻቸውን ይረግማሉ። \q ስለ እናቶቻቸውም መልካም ነገር አይናገሩም።

hi.L: [ऐसी] पीढ़ी [है जो] अपने पिता को शाप देती है \q और अपनी माता को आशीर्वाद नहीं देती।
hi.B: ऐसे लोग हैं जो अपने पिता को शाप देते हैं \q और अपनी माँ के बारे में कभी अच्छा नहीं बोलते।
hi.R: कुछ लोग अपने पिता को शाप देते हैं। \q उनके पास अपनी माँ के बारे में कहने को कोई अच्छी बात नहीं होती।

ru.L: [Есть] род, [который] проклинает своего отца \q и не благословляет свою мать.
ru.B: Есть люди, которые проклинают своих отцов \q и никогда не скажут доброго слова о своих матерях.
ru.R: Некоторые люди проклинают своих отцов. \q У них нет ни одного доброго слова о своих матерях.

ja.L: 自分の父を呪い、 \q 自分の母を祝福しない世代がある。
ja.B: 父を呪い、 \q 母を決して良く言わない人々がいる。
ja.R: 自分の父親を呪う人たちがいる。 \q その人たちは、母親について、何も良いことを言わない。

decisions.choice: a generation: a kind of people
decisions.reason: The word (dor) can mean a class of people with a common character (Psalm 24:6). Verses 11–14 describe four marks of such people: contempt for parents, self-righteousness, pride, and cruelty.
Cursing a parent was a capital crime under the law (Exodus 21:17). Compare 20:20; 30:17.
Literal keeps the Hebrew's "generation" in all four sayings; the meaning decision reads it as a kind of people, which Balanced and Readable say plainly ("ሰዎች አሉ").

A generation here is a kind of people (meaning m1). Literal keeps "पीढ़ी" in each of verses 11-14, so the four lines open alike as in the Hebrew; Balanced and Readable say "there are people", as the English does.

dor here is a kind of people (m1), not an age group; "род" can mean that in Russian, where "поколение" would be read as people born at one time. Balanced and Readable say "есть люди", "некоторые люди".
The word means a kind of people here (meaning m1); Literal keeps the word, Balanced and Readable say what it means, as the English.

source.text: דּ֭וֹר טָה֣וֹר בְּעֵינָ֑יו וּ֝מִצֹּאָת֗וֹ לֹ֣א רֻחָֽץ׃

records.literal_gloss: A generation pure in its eyes, but from its filth it has not been washed.

en.L: [There is] a generation [that is] pure in its own eyes, \q yet it has not been washed from its filth.
en.B: There are people who think they are clean, \q yet their filth has never been washed away.
en.R: Some people think they are pure. \q But they are still dirty with sin.

fr.L: [Il y a] une génération [qui est] pure à ses propres yeux, \q et pourtant elle n’a pas été lavée de sa souillure.
fr.B: Il y a des gens qui se croient purs, \q et pourtant leur saleté n’a jamais été lavée.
fr.R: Certains se croient purs. \q Mais ils sont encore sales de leur péché.

sw.L: [Kuna] kizazi [kilicho] safi machoni pake chenyewe, \q lakini hakijaoshwa uchafu wake.
sw.B: Kuna watu wanaodhani ni safi, \q lakini uchafu wao haujaoshwa kamwe.
sw.R: Watu wengine hudhani ni safi. \q Lakini bado ni wachafu kwa dhambi.

es.L: [Hay] una generación [que es] pura a sus propios ojos, \q pero no ha sido lavada de su inmundicia.
es.B: Hay gente que se cree limpia, \q y sin embargo su suciedad nunca ha sido lavada.
es.R: Algunos se creen puros. \q Pero siguen sucios de pecado.

vi.L: [Có] một dòng dõi tự cho mình [là] thanh sạch, \q nhưng chưa được rửa sạch khỏi sự ô uế của mình.
vi.B: Có những người nghĩ rằng mình trong sạch, \q nhưng sự dơ bẩn của họ chưa bao giờ được rửa đi.
vi.R: Có người nghĩ mình trong sạch. \q Nhưng họ vẫn còn dơ bẩn vì tội lỗi.

ko.L: 자기 눈에 깨끗하나 \q 자기 더러움에서 씻기지 않은 세대가 [있다].
ko.B: 스스로 깨끗하다고 생각하지만 \q 그 더러움이 한 번도 씻긴 적 없는 사람들이 있다.
ko.R: 어떤 사람들은 자기가 깨끗하다고 생각한다. \q 그러나 그들은 여전히 죄로 더럽다.

pt.L: [Há] uma geração [que é] pura aos seus próprios olhos, \q mas não foi lavada da sua imundície.
pt.B: Há gente que se acha limpa, \q mas a sua sujeira nunca foi lavada.
pt.R: Algumas pessoas acham que são puras. \q Mas continuam sujas de pecado.

am.L: በራሱ ዓይን ንጹሕ የሆነ ትውልድ [አለ]፤ \q ከእድፉ ግን አልታጠበም።
am.B: ንጹሐን እንደሆኑ የሚያስቡ ሰዎች አሉ፤ \q ርኩሰታቸው ግን ከቶ አልታጠበም።
am.R: አንዳንድ ሰዎች ንጹሐን እንደሆኑ ያስባሉ። \q ነገር ግን አሁንም በኃጢአት ቆሽሸዋል።

hi.L: [ऐसी] पीढ़ी [है जो] अपनी दृष्टि में शुद्ध [है], \q फिर भी उसका मैल धोया नहीं गया।
hi.B: ऐसे लोग हैं जो अपने आप को शुद्ध समझते हैं, \q फिर भी उनकी गंदगी कभी धोई नहीं गई।
hi.R: कुछ लोग सोचते हैं कि वे शुद्ध हैं। \q पर वे अब भी पाप से गंदे हैं।

ru.L: [Есть] род, чистый в своих глазах, \q но от нечистот своих не омытый.
ru.B: Есть люди, которые считают себя чистыми, \q но их грязь так и не смыта.
ru.R: Некоторые люди думают, что они чисты. \q Но они всё ещё грязны от греха.

ja.L: 自分の目には清いが、 \q その汚れから洗われていない世代がある。
ja.B: 自分は清いと思っていながら、 \q その汚れを一度も洗い落とされたことのない人々がいる。
ja.R: 自分は清いと思っている人たちがいる。 \q しかし、その人たちは、まだ罪で汚れている。

decisions.reason: The word (tso) is a strong, coarse word for filth (Isaiah 4:4; 28:8).

source.text: דּ֭וֹר מָה־רָמ֣וּ עֵינָ֑יו וְ֝עַפְעַפָּ֗יו יִנָּשֵֽׂאוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: A generation, how lofty [are] its eyes, and its eyelids are lifted up!

en.L: [There is] a generation, how lofty [are] its eyes, \q and its eyelids are lifted up!
en.B: There are people whose eyes are so haughty, \q whose glances are full of scorn!
en.R: Some people are so proud! \q They look down on everyone.

fr.L: [Il y a] une génération, que ses yeux sont hautains, \q et ses paupières sont relevées !
fr.B: Il y a des gens qui ont le regard si hautain, \q et des yeux pleins de mépris !
fr.R: Certains sont si orgueilleux ! \q Ils regardent tout le monde de haut.

sw.L: [Kuna] kizazi, jinsi macho yake [yalivyo] ya kiburi, \q na kope zake zimeinuliwa juu!
sw.B: Kuna watu ambao macho yao yana kiburi kingi mno, \q ambao mitazamo yao imejaa dharau!
sw.R: Watu wengine wana kiburi kingi mno! \q Huwadharau watu wote.

es.L: [Hay] una generación, ¡qué altivos [son] sus ojos, \q y sus párpados se levantan!
es.B: ¡Hay gente de mirada tan altiva, \q de miradas tan llenas de desprecio!
es.R: ¡Qué orgullosa es alguna gente! \q Miran a todos por encima del hombro.

vi.L: [Có] một dòng dõi, mắt [họ] cao ngạo biết bao, \q và mí mắt họ ngước lên!
vi.B: Có những người có đôi mắt kiêu căng biết bao, \q ánh nhìn đầy khinh miệt!
vi.R: Có người kiêu ngạo biết bao! \q Họ coi thường mọi người.

ko.L: 눈이 얼마나 높으며 \q 눈꺼풀이 치켜 올라간 세대가 [있다]!
ko.B: 눈이 몹시 교만하고 \q 눈길에 경멸이 가득한 사람들이 있다!
ko.R: 어떤 사람들은 아주 교만하다! \q 모든 사람을 깔본다.

pt.L: [Há] uma geração, como são altivos os seus olhos, \q e as suas pálpebras se erguem!
pt.B: Há gente de olhar tão arrogante, \q de olhares tão cheios de desprezo!
pt.R: Algumas pessoas são tão orgulhosas! \q Olham todo mundo de cima.

am.L: ትውልድ [አለ]፤ ዓይኖቹ ምንኛ ከፍ ያሉ ናቸው! \q ሽፋሽፍቶቹም ወደ ላይ የተነሡ ናቸው!
am.B: ዓይኖቻቸው በትዕቢት የተሞሉ፣ \q አስተያየታቸውም በንቀት የተሞላ ሰዎች አሉ!
am.R: አንዳንድ ሰዎች ምንኛ ትዕቢተኞች ናቸው! \q ሁሉንም ዝቅ አድርገው ያያሉ።

hi.L: [ऐसी] पीढ़ी [है], उसकी आँखें कितनी ऊँची [हैं], \q और उसकी पलकें ऊपर उठी रहती हैं!
hi.B: ऐसे लोग हैं जिनकी आँखें कितनी घमंड भरी हैं, \q जिनकी नज़रें तिरस्कार से भरी हैं!
hi.R: कुछ लोग कितने घमंडी होते हैं! \q वे हर किसी को नीची नज़र से देखते हैं।

ru.L: [Есть] род — как высоки глаза его, \q и веки его подняты!
ru.B: Есть люди, у которых такой надменный взгляд, \q такие презрительные глаза!
ru.R: Некоторые люди такие гордые! \q Они смотрят на всех свысока.

ja.L: ある世代は、なんとその目は高く、 \q そのまぶたは上がっていることか！
ja.B: なんと高慢な目つきをした人々がいることか、 \q そのまなざしは侮りに満ちている！
ja.R: なんと高ぶっている人たちがいることか！ \q その人たちは、みんなを見下している。

decisions.reason: As in 6:17 and 21:4.

source.text: דּ֤וֹר׀חֲרָב֣וֹת שִׁנָּיו֮ וּֽמַאֲכָל֪וֹת מְֽתַלְּעֹ֫תָ֥יולֶאֱכֹ֣ל עֲנִיִּ֣ים מֵאֶ֑רֶץ וְ֝אֶבְיוֹנִ֗ים מֵאָדָֽם׃פ

records.literal_gloss: A generation [whose] teeth [are] swords and [whose] jaws [are] knives, to devour [the] afflicted from [the] earth and [the] needy from among humankind.

en.L: [There is] a generation [whose] teeth [are] swords and [whose] jaws [are] knives, \q to devour [the] afflicted from [the] earth \q and [the] needy from among humankind.
en.B: There are people whose teeth are swords and whose jaws are set with knives, \q to devour the afflicted off the earth \q and the needy from the human race.
en.R: Some people are like wild animals with teeth as sharp as swords and knives. \q They destroy poor people and take everything they have.

fr.L: [Il y a] une génération [dont] les dents [sont] des épées et [dont] les mâchoires [sont] des couteaux, \q pour dévorer les humbles de la terre \q et les indigents parmi les humains.
fr.B: Il y a des gens dont les dents sont des épées et les mâchoires des couteaux, \q pour dévorer les humbles et les ôter de la terre, \q et les indigents du milieu des humains.
fr.R: Certains sont comme des bêtes sauvages aux dents aussi tranchantes que des épées et des couteaux. \q Ils détruisent les pauvres et leur prennent tout ce qu’ils ont.

sw.L: [Kuna] kizazi [ambacho] meno yake [ni] panga na magego yake [ni] visu, \q kuwala wanyonge watoweke duniani \q na wahitaji [watoweke] miongoni mwa wanadamu.
sw.B: Kuna watu ambao meno yao ni panga na magego yao ni visu, \q ili kuwala wanyonge watoweke duniani \q na wahitaji watoweke katika jamii ya wanadamu.
sw.R: Watu wengine ni kama wanyama wa porini wenye meno makali kama panga na visu. \q Huwaangamiza maskini na kuwanyang'anya kila kitu walicho nacho.

es.L: [Hay] una generación [cuyos] dientes [son] espadas y [cuyas] mandíbulas [son] cuchillos, \q para devorar a [los] afligidos de [la] tierra \q y a [los] necesitados de entre los seres humanos.
es.B: Hay gente cuyos dientes son espadas y cuyas mandíbulas están armadas de cuchillos, \q para devorar a los afligidos de la tierra \q y a los necesitados del género humano.
es.R: Algunos son como animales salvajes, con dientes tan afilados como espadas y cuchillos. \q Destruyen a los pobres y les quitan todo lo que tienen.

vi.L: [Có] một dòng dõi răng [là] gươm và hàm [là] dao, \q để nuốt [người] khốn khổ khỏi mặt đất \q và [người] thiếu thốn khỏi loài người.
vi.B: Có những người răng như gươm, hàm như dao, \q để nuốt chửng người khốn khổ khỏi mặt đất \q và người thiếu thốn khỏi loài người.
vi.R: Có người giống như thú dữ, răng sắc như gươm và dao. \q Họ hủy hoại người nghèo và lấy hết mọi thứ người ta có.

ko.L: 이빨이 칼이요 어금니가 칼날인 세대가 [있으니], \q 땅에서 고난받는 자들을 삼키고 \q 사람들 가운데서 궁핍한 자들을 [삼킨다].
ko.B: 이빨이 칼 같고 턱에 칼날이 박힌 사람들이 있어서, \q 고난받는 사람들을 땅에서 삼키고 \q 궁핍한 사람들을 사람들 가운데서 삼킨다.
ko.R: 어떤 사람들은 칼처럼 날카로운 이빨을 가진 들짐승과 같다. \q 그들은 가난한 사람들을 망하게 하고 그들이 가진 것을 모두 빼앗는다.

pt.L: [Há] uma geração [cujos] dentes [são] espadas e [cujas] mandíbulas [são] facas, \q para devorar os aflitos da terra \q e os necessitados do meio da humanidade.
pt.B: Há gente cujos dentes são espadas e cujas mandíbulas são facas, \q para devorar os aflitos da face da terra \q e os necessitados do meio da humanidade.
pt.R: Algumas pessoas são como animais selvagens, com dentes afiados como espadas e facas. \q Destroem os pobres e tomam tudo o que eles têm.

am.L: ጥርሶቹ ሰይፎች፣ መንጋጋዎቹም ቢላዎች የሆኑ ትውልድ [አለ]፤ \q ጐስቋሎችን ከምድር ላይ፣ \q ምስኪኖችንም ከሰው ልጆች መካከል ይበላ ዘንድ።
am.B: ጥርሳቸው ሰይፍ፣ መንጋጋቸውም ቢላ የሆነ ሰዎች አሉ፤ \q ድሆችን ከምድር ላይ፣ \q ምስኪኖችንም ከሰው ዘር መካከል ይበሉ ዘንድ።
am.R: አንዳንድ ሰዎች ጥርሳቸው እንደ ሰይፍና እንደ ቢላ የተሳለ አውሬዎችን ይመስላሉ። \q ድሆችን ያጠፋሉ፤ ያላቸውንም ሁሉ ይወስዳሉ።

hi.L: [ऐसी] पीढ़ी [है जिसके] दाँत तलवारें और [जिसकी] दाढ़ें छुरियाँ [हैं], \q कि दीन लोगों को पृथ्वी पर से \q और दरिद्रों को मनुष्यों के बीच से खा जाए।
hi.B: ऐसे लोग हैं जिनके दाँत तलवारें हैं और जिनकी दाढ़ों में छुरियाँ जड़ी हैं, \q कि दीनों को धरती से मिटा दें \q और दरिद्रों को मनुष्यों के बीच से खा जाएँ।
hi.R: कुछ लोग जंगली जानवरों की तरह हैं, जिनके दाँत तलवारों और छुरियों जैसे तेज़ हैं। \q वे ग़रीबों को नष्ट करते हैं और उनका सब कुछ छीन लेते हैं।

ru.L: [Есть] род, [у которого] зубы — мечи и челюсти — ножи, \q чтобы пожирать угнетённых с земли \q и нищих среди людей.
ru.B: Есть люди, у которых зубы — мечи, а челюсти — ножи, \q чтобы пожирать угнетённых на земле \q и нищих из рода человеческого.
ru.R: Некоторые люди как дикие звери: их зубы остры, как мечи и ножи. \q Они губят бедных людей и отнимают у них всё.

ja.L: 歯が剣、あごが小刀である世代がある、 \q 地から苦しむ者たちを、 \q 人の中から貧しい者たちを食い尽くすために。
ja.B: 歯は剣、あごは小刀のような人々がいる。 \q 苦しむ者を地から、 \q 貧しい者を人の中から食い尽くすのだ。
ja.R: 剣や小刀のように鋭い歯を持つ野獣のような人たちがいる。 \q その人たちは、貧しい人たちを滅ぼし、持っている物をすべて奪う。

decisions.reason: The picture is of a beast devouring prey. The poor are eaten up by oppression (Psalm 14:4; Micah 3:2–3).

decisions.choice: "les humbles" and "les indigents" for the afflicted and the needy
decisions.reason: As the terms note sets for these words; Readable says simply "les pauvres", as the English does.

source.text: לַֽעֲלוּקָ֨ה׀שְׁתֵּ֥י בָנוֹת֮ הַ֤ב׀הַ֥ב שָׁל֣וֹשׁ הֵ֭נָּה לֹ֣א תִשְׂבַּ֑עְנָה אַ֝רְבַּ֗ע לֹא־אָ֥מְרוּ הֽוֹן׃

records.literal_gloss: To a leech [are] two daughters: "Give! Give!" Three [things] they are not satisfied; four do not say, "Enough!":

en.L: [The] leech has two daughters, "Give!" [and] "Give!" Three [things] are never satisfied; \q four never say, "Enough!":
en.B: The leech has two daughters, both called "Give!" Three things can never be filled; \q four never say, "Enough!":
en.R: A leech has two daughters, and both are named "Give me!" \q There are three things, even four, that always want more and never say, "That is enough!":

fr.L: La sangsue a deux filles : « Donne ! » [et] « Donne ! » Trois [choses] ne sont jamais rassasiées ; \q quatre ne disent jamais : « Assez ! » :
fr.B: La sangsue a deux filles, qui s’appellent toutes deux « Donne ! ». Trois choses ne sont jamais remplies ; \q quatre ne disent jamais : « Assez ! » :
fr.R: Une sangsue a deux filles, et toutes deux s’appellent « Donne-moi ! ». \q Il y a trois choses, et même quatre, qui en veulent toujours plus et ne disent jamais : « Ça suffit ! » :

sw.L: Ruba ana binti wawili, "Nipe!" [na] "Nipe!" Kuna [vitu] vitatu visivyoshiba kamwe; \q vinne visivyosema kamwe, "Inatosha!":
sw.B: Ruba ana binti wawili, wote wanaitwa "Nipe!" Kuna vitu vitatu visivyoweza kujazwa kamwe; \q vinne visivyosema kamwe, "Inatosha!":
sw.R: Ruba ana binti wawili, na wote wawili wanaitwa "Nipe!" \q Kuna vitu vitatu, naam, vinne, vinavyotaka zaidi siku zote na kamwe havisemi, "Inatosha sasa!":

es.L: [La] sanguijuela tiene dos hijas: «¡Dame!» [y] «¡Dame!». Tres [cosas] nunca se sacian; \q cuatro nunca dicen: «¡Basta!»:
es.B: La sanguijuela tiene dos hijas, y las dos se llaman «¡Dame!». Hay tres cosas que nunca se llenan; \q cuatro que nunca dicen: «¡Basta!»:
es.R: La sanguijuela tiene dos hijas, y las dos se llaman «¡Dame!». \q Hay tres cosas, y hasta cuatro, que siempre quieren más y nunca dicen: «¡Ya es suficiente!»:

vi.L: Con đỉa có hai con gái: "Đưa đây!" [và] "Đưa đây!" Có ba [điều] không bao giờ thỏa mãn; \q bốn [điều] không bao giờ nói: "Đủ rồi!":
vi.B: Con đỉa có hai con gái, cả hai đều tên là "Đưa đây!" Có ba điều không bao giờ đầy; \q bốn điều không bao giờ nói: "Đủ rồi!":
vi.R: Con đỉa có hai con gái, cả hai đều tên là "Đưa cho tôi!" \q Có ba điều, thậm chí bốn, luôn muốn thêm và không bao giờ nói: "Vậy là đủ rồi!":

ko.L: 거머리에게는 두 딸이 있으니, "다오!" "다오!" [한다]. 만족하지 않는 것이 셋이요, \q "그만!" 하고 말하지 않는 것이 넷이다.
ko.B: 거머리에게는 두 딸이 있는데, 둘 다 이름이 "다오!"이다. 결코 채워지지 않는 것이 셋, \q "이제 됐다!" 하고 말하지 않는 것이 넷 있다.
ko.R: 거머리에게는 두 딸이 있는데, 둘 다 이름이 "더 줘!"이다. \q 늘 더 원하고 "이제 됐다!" 하고 말하지 않는 것이 셋, 아니 넷이 있다.

pt.L: A sanguessuga tem duas filhas: "Dá!" [e] "Dá!" Três [coisas] nunca se saciam; \q quatro nunca dizem: "Basta!":
pt.B: A sanguessuga tem duas filhas, as duas chamadas "Dá!" Três coisas nunca se enchem; \q quatro nunca dizem: "Basta!":
pt.R: A sanguessuga tem duas filhas, e as duas se chamam "Me dá!" \q Há três coisas, e até quatro, que sempre querem mais e nunca dizem: "Já chega!":

am.L: አልቅት ሁለት ሴቶች ልጆች አሏት፤ «ስጥ!» [እና] «ስጥ!» [የሚሉ]። ሦስት [ነገሮች] ፈጽሞ አይጠግቡም፤ \q አራትም «በቃ!» ፈጽሞ አይሉም፦
am.B: አልቅት ሁለት ሴቶች ልጆች አሏት፤ ሁለቱም «ስጥ!» ይባላሉ። ፈጽሞ የማይሞሉ ሦስት ነገሮች አሉ፤ \q «በቃ!» የማይሉ አራት ነገሮች አሉ፦
am.R: አልቅት ሁለት ሴቶች ልጆች አሏት፤ ሁለቱም «ስጠኝ!» ይባላሉ። \q ሁልጊዜ ተጨማሪ የሚፈልጉ፣ «ይበቃኛል!» የማይሉ ሦስት፣ እንዲያውም አራት ነገሮች አሉ፦

hi.L: जोंक की दो बेटियाँ [हैं], "दे!" [और] "दे!" तीन [चीज़ें] कभी तृप्त नहीं होतीं; \q चार कभी नहीं कहतीं, "बस!":
hi.B: जोंक की दो बेटियाँ हैं, दोनों का नाम "दे!" है। तीन चीज़ें कभी नहीं भरतीं; \q चार कभी नहीं कहतीं, "बस!":
hi.R: जोंक की दो बेटियाँ हैं, और दोनों का नाम है "मुझे दे!" \q तीन चीज़ें हैं, बल्कि चार, जो हमेशा और चाहती हैं और कभी नहीं कहतीं, "अब बहुत हो गया!":

ru.L: У пиявки две дочери: «Дай!» [и] «Дай!» Три [вещи] не насыщаются, \q четыре не говорят: «Довольно!»:
ru.B: У пиявки две дочери, и обе зовутся «Дай!» Три вещи никогда не бывают сыты, \q четыре никогда не скажут: «Довольно!»:
ru.R: У пиявки две дочери, и обеих зовут «Дай мне!» \q Есть три вещи, даже четыре, которым всегда мало и которые никогда не говорят: «Хватит!»:

ja.L: ヒルには二人の娘がいる、「くれ！」「くれ！」と。満ち足りることのないものが三つ、 \q 「もう十分だ！」と言わないものが四つある。
ja.B: ヒルには二人の娘がいて、どちらも「くれ！」という名だ。決して満たされないものが三つ、 \q 「もう十分だ！」と言わないものが四つある。
ja.R: ヒルには二人の娘がいて、どちらも「ちょうだい！」という名前だ。 \q いつも、もっとほしがって、「もう十分だ！」と決して言わないものが三つ、いや四つある。

decisions.reason: The word (aluqah) appears only here. Its two "daughters" may be its two suckers, named for what they always ask.
The pattern "three, even four" builds to the last item, which is often the point (Amos 1:3; Job 5:19). Verses 15–31 contain several such sayings.

decisions.choice: One formula for the numerical sayings: "ሦስት ... አራትም" (L, B); "ሦስት፣ እንዲያውም አራት ነገሮች አሉ" (R)
decisions.reason: The sayings in 30:15, 18, 21 and 29 climb from three to four. Literal and Balanced keep the two parallel lines; Readable joins them, as the English does, with እንዲያውም ("even"), the same words each time. ወይም ("or") would make the number sound vague rather than climactic.
The ordinary Amharic word for the bloodsucking worm the meaning decision names.
The numerical saying names three and then four (meaning m2): the last number is the one the list fills. Hindi keeps the pattern at each level, as the English does, here and in verses 18, 21 and 29.

decisions.choice: "три ... четыре" kept as in the Hebrew
decisions.reason: The numerical saying (m2) names three and then four as a way of building to the last item; Literal and Balanced keep the two lines, Readable joins them ("три вещи, даже четыре") as its English does, here and in verses 18, 21 and 29.

decisions.choice: 'aluqah "ヒル" in katakana at every level (as "アリ", 6:6); the numerical sayings "三つ…四つ" (L, B), "三つ、いや四つ" (R)
decisions.reason: 蛭 is not a Jōyō kanji and ひる in kana reads as "noon"; Readable joins the "three ... four" into one phrase, as the English Readable "three things, even four".
